title: SaaS Growth Without Dilution
summary: A subscription business used a non-dilutive structure to fund growth while keeping the cap table clean.
structure: Matched to a structure aligned to recurring revenue economics
Clear repayment logic tied to cash-flow patterns

narrative.title: The constraint
narrative.body: The team needed capital to scale demand while preserving ownership and flexibility.

narrative.title: The structure
narrative.body: A recurring-revenue-aligned option created predictable repayment with room for seasonality.

narrative.title: The result
narrative.body: Funding arrived quickly, allowing the team to execute growth plans on schedule.

title: E-commerce Inventory Scale
summary: A brand financed inventory and marketing in a way that matched its cash conversion cycle.
structure: Funding mapped to inventory turns and sales cycle
Flexible repayment tied to revenue performance
Clear scenario modeling for peak season

outcomes.label: Outcome
outcomes.value: Improved in-stock rates during peak demand

narrative.title: The constraint
narrative.body: Peak season required inventory and marketing spend before revenue landed.

narrative.title: The structure
narrative.body: A cash-flow-aligned option prevented over-compressing runway during dips.

narrative.title: The result
narrative.body: The brand stayed in stock and scaled without trading away equity.

title: Asset-Backed Equipment Expansion
summary: A services operator leveraged equipment assets to expand capacity while keeping costs efficient.

narrative.title: The constraint
narrative.body: Capacity was capped by equipment limits; equity was too expensive.

narrative.title: The structure
narrative.body: Collateralized financing reduced cost while maintaining operating control.

narrative.title: The result
narrative.body: The operator expanded capacity and stabilized unit economics.
